sourceAgreement.currentHeroAndLaunch: The current hero page and dated formal launch contain the same complete Yunzheng and Huoxin text. No conflicting later official change was found in a bounded official audit.
sourceAgreement.notServerFaq: No dedicated official FAQ or current anniversary game selector was captured; the public game entry returned 403. Interpretations below are explicit repository engineering readings, not claimed server rulings.

skills.name: 韵筝
skills.text: 锁定技，游戏开始时，你的初始手牌增加“筝”标记且不计入手牌上限，手牌有“筝”的其他角色非锁定技失效。

skills.name: 惑心
skills.text: 你使用非装备牌时，可以展示一名其他角色一张手牌并标记为“筝”。若此牌与你使用的牌花色相同或已被标记过，你可以获得之。

engineeringInterpretations.markedIdentity: A Zheng mark belongs permanently to the physical entity, including entities marked by Huoxin, across zones and transfers. Marks do not manufacture a new card or copy its identity.
engineeringInterpretations.handLimit: Use the established Le entity-family convention: a current Yunzheng holder exempts marked entities in that holder's actual Hand. An unrelated holder does not acquire a hand-limit skill merely by receiving a marked card.
engineeringInterpretations.suppression: With another living current Yunzheng source present, the current holder of any marked Hand entity loses qualification for every non-locked skill, including later grants. Locked grants remain qualified. Real hand movement, death and source loss change qualification immediately; accepted native children keep their exact issued rights.
engineeringInterpretations.suit: Compare the actual used card's effective suit frozen at the accepted true Use against the revealed physical card; Suit.None is not a suit. An old mark independently qualifies optional obtain even when the used card has no suit. Freeze old-mark eligibility before adding the new mark.
engineeringInterpretations.useBoundary: Every accepted true Use of a non-equipment card can issue Huoxin, including response, rescue, forced and targetless Uses. Pure Played is excluded. Select another living hand owner independently of original targets; reveal the exact selected card and optionally obtain that same entity through native movement.
